deep_research.notes: The Stripe claims are well supported. The central AWS retention claims ('impractical', 'lifetime plus interval', 'for some interval') and the parameter-mismatch claim do not appear in the Builders' Library excerpt, which ends at the semantic-equivalence section. The EC2 excerpt contains only the retry table, so the token-length and scoping claims are unsupported. The EC2 retry-guidance claim and the 243x / capped-backoff claims (not among the 8 listed) are supported. Gaps are disclosed. The point about bounded retries adds some narrowing.

It explicitly declines to rely on the unverified EC2/ECS snippet figures. The Stripe v2 statement and the comparison are uncited. Limitations are well disclosed.
